topic: Immunization, Infection Control, and Isolation Precautions
stemEn: A NICU department had 5 cases of MRSA in a short period of time. What is the most likely cause of this outbreak?
explanationAr: المصدر يربط outbreaks في NICU غالبًا بانتقال MRSA عبر أيدي العاملين أو colonized healthcare workers؛ لذلك poor infection-control compliance هو المفتاح.
reasoningEn: Hand-mediated patient-to-patient transmission is a recognized mechanism for MRSA spread in NICUs.
incorrectOptionsAr: Antibiotic misuse قد يزيد selection pressure لكنه لا يفسر transmission cluster بنفس مباشرة ضعف infection control.
clinicalPearl: Outbreak control starts with strict hand hygiene, contact precautions and surveillance according to local policy.

topic: Immunization, Infection Control, and Isolation Precautions
stemEn: A preterm infant in intensive care suddenly deteriorated. Blood cultures grew coagulase-negative Staphylococcus from central and peripheral lines. What is your management?

options.text: Remove central line (option text incomplete in recall)

explanationAr: المصدر يختار vancomycin، لكنه يوضح أن management الأفضل في recall هو start vancomycin AND repeat blood culture، مع التفكير بإزالة central line إذا كان الطفل unstable أو استمرت cultures إيجابية. لذلك السؤال ناقص الخيارات ويحتاج مراجعة.
reasoningEn: The source key is vancomycin, but its own explanation describes a combined management plan rather than one isolated step.
incorrectOptionsAr: Cefotaxime لا يغطي methicillin-resistant CoNS بشكل موثوق. Repeat culture مهم لكنه ليس وحده علاج طفل متدهور.
clinicalPearl: Central-line infection decisions depend on clinical stability, organism and persistence of bacteremia.

stemEn: A mother who has genital warts delivered a term baby by cesarean section. What precautions should she follow during breastfeeding?
explanationAr: مفتاح المصدر هو hand washing، لكن explanation يتحدث عن active herpetic lesions وليس genital warts/HPV، لذلك يوجد mismatch واضح بين stem والشرح ويجب عدم نشره كإجابة موثقة قبل المراجعة.
reasoningEn: The recalled answer is hand hygiene, but the supporting source passage discusses herpes rather than HPV/genital warts.
clinicalPearl: Preserve the recall, but verify the actual maternal infection before assigning pathogen-specific breastfeeding precautions.

stemEn: An infant presented with productive cough and post-tussive vomiting consistent with pertussis. What is the proper isolation?

options.text: Droplet isolation until 5 days on treatment
Contact isolation after 24 hours from starting antibiotics

explanationAr: المصدر يختار droplet precautions حتى إكمال 5 أيام من effective antibiotic therapy.
reasoningEn: Pertussis requires droplet precautions during the infectious period; the recall uses five days after effective therapy begins.
incorrectOptionsAr: Contact isolation وحده لا يعكس route الأساسي لpertussis في السؤال.
clinicalPearl: Also address close-contact prophylaxis according to current public-health guidance.

stemEn: The mother of a child with positive streptococcal pharyngitis asks when the child can return to school. What is the answer?

reasoningEn: The source recall uses 24 hours after treatment starts.
clinicalPearl: Return-to-school criteria should follow the current public-health guideline used by the site.

stemEn: When can isolation for Neisseria meningitidis infection be discontinued?

options.text: After 24 hours of starting effective antibiotics

explanationAr: المصدر يذكر استمرار droplet precautions لمدة 24 ساعة بعد بدء effective antibiotics، ثم يمكن إيقافها.
reasoningEn: The recall states viable organisms are no longer isolated after 24 hours of effective therapy.
incorrectOptionsAr: 48 ساعة أطول من المدة المذكورة في المصدر.
clinicalPearl: Close contacts still require appropriate chemoprophylaxis independent of the patient's isolation end time.

stemEn: A girl had fever for 3 days then developed a slapped-cheek rash after the fever resolved. When can she return to school?
explanationAr: في fifth disease يكون الطفل غالبًا أكثر عدوى قبل ظهور rash؛ عندما يظهر slapped-cheek rash يكون عادةً لم يعد معديًا، ولذلك المصدر يسمح بالعودة الآن.
reasoningEn: The rash represents the postinfectious immune phase; exclusion from school after diagnosis is not useful in the source.
clinicalPearl: Exposure counseling matters for pregnant and selected hematologic/immunocompromised contacts.

topic: Immunization, Infection Control, and Isolation Precautions
stemEn: A 7-year-old unvaccinated child with asthma has been on methylprednisolone 2 mg/kg/day for the last 7 days and had contact with a measles case 2 days ago. What will you give him?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار MMR. ويذكر أن high-dose corticosteroid يُعد severe immunosuppression عادةً إذا استمر ≥14 consecutive days؛ هنا 7 أيام فقط، لذلك المصدر لا يعامله كcontraindication للlive vaccine.
reasoningEn: The source uses the duration threshold to support MMR rather than immune globulin in this recall.
incorrectOptionsAr: IG يُستخدم في فئات عالية الخطورة/موانع MMR وفق التوقيت والحالة المناعية. لا prophylaxis غير مناسب في susceptible exposed child.
clinicalPearl: Measles PEP is highly time-sensitive and must follow current Red Book/public-health guidance.

stemEn: A 4-month-old medically healthy infant had contact with a measles case; the time since exposure was not mentioned. What will you give him?

reasoningEn: The recall key is immune globulin, but the missing exposure interval limits confidence.
clinicalPearl: Never finalize measles PEP without age and time-since-exposure.

stemEn: A fully immunized child had contact with a patient with varicella. Which person would you anticipate to have more severe infection?
explanationAr: المصدر يعد long-term salicylate therapy من عوامل increased risk التي قد تستدعي consideration of antiviral treatment في varicella.
reasoningEn: Chronic salicylate use is the risk factor identified in the source.
incorrectOptionsAr: العمر <12 سنة بحد ذاته ليس عامل severe varicella في هذا السؤال، وotitis/antibiotic use ليسا المفتاح المذكور.
clinicalPearl: Varicella risk stratification depends on age, immune status, pregnancy and selected chronic therapies.

stemEn: A child with systemic lupus erythematosus on oral steroid 20 mg twice daily was exposed to varicella. What will you do?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار VZIG بعد exposure في immunosuppressed child. الجرعة/التوقيت وأي antiviral إضافي يجب مراجعتها حسب Red Book الحالية.
reasoningEn: The recalled post-exposure strategy is passive immunoprophylaxis with VZIG.
incorrectOptionsAr: Live varicella vaccine قد يكون contraindicated في significant immunosuppression. إضافة acyclovir تعتمد على guideline/clinical context وليست مفتاح المصدر.
clinicalPearl: Varicella PEP in immunocompromised patients is time-sensitive and guideline-dependent.

stemEn: A child was found to have hepatitis A. What is your advice for his healthy 4-month-old brother after exposure?
